main_clause_rules.description: In declarative main clauses, the finite verb must occupy the second syntactic position.

canonical_svo.example: Jan leest een boek in de bibliotheek

inversion_trigger.description: When an adjunct, adverbial phrase, or direct object is fronted into Position 1 (Vorfeld), subject-verb inversion is obligatory (Verb = Pos 2, Subject = Pos 3).

separable_verb_bracket.description: In main clauses, separable prefix moves to the clause coda (Satzklammer / verb bracket).

subordinate_clause_rules.description: In subordinate clauses introduced by a subordinator, the verb cluster is pushed to the clause final position (SOV).
examples: als hij morgen naar school gaat
